label: Death-receptor apoptosis and necroptosis
reason: Fas/TRAIL/TNF death-receptor signalling via caspase-8, c-FLIP, BID and RIPK1 necroptosis; one stray T-cell module.

label: Sema3A axon repulsion and collateral sprouting
reason: Semaphorin-3A/CRMP/PAK growth-cone repulsion and regulation of axon extension and sprouting form one neuronal theme.

label: Lipoprotein, cholesterol and bile acid homeostasis
reason: Lipoprotein assembly/clearance, cholesterol efflux/uptake, LXR/SREBP control and bile acid synthesis are one sterol homeostasis axis; few generic receptor-trafficking terms.

label: cAMP-PKA-CREB signalling
reason: Adenylate cyclase activation, cAMP synthesis, PKA activation and CREB phosphorylation are one second-messenger pathway.

label: Cell division and genome maintenance
reason: Mitotic/meiotic division machinery plus DNA replication and repair (BER, MMR, HR, FA, TLS), linked by cell-cycle checkpoint control of genome integrity.

label: HDL formation and macrophage cholesterol efflux
reason: ABCA1/ApoA-I HDL assembly, LXR-driven efflux and foam-cell regulation form one reverse cholesterol transport theme.

label: Negative regulation of T cell responses
reason: Suppression of T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine production with Treg/Th17 differentiation control is one immunoregulatory theme.

label: Neurotransmitter control of GI motility
reason: Serotonin, muscarinic and tachykinin receptor signalling driving gut smooth muscle contraction and gastric secretion; stomach development minor.

label: Endodermal gut epithelium and pancreas development
reason: Intestinal/hepatic epithelial identity (HNF4, CDX, FOXA) and pancreatic lineage specification share endodermal origin and transcription factors; leukocyte migration and adrenal odd.

label: Lysosomal glycan and GAG degradation
reason: Mucopolysaccharidoses, glycosphingolipid, sialic acid and oligosaccharide lysosomal catabolism form one lysosomal storage theme.

label: Kidney and urinary tract development
reason: Metanephros, ureteric bud, nephric duct and nephron progenitor regulation are one renal developmental theme.

label: Lipid droplet and triglyceride storage
reason: Lipid droplet formation/breakdown, lipophagy, lipolysis and adipocyte triglyceride storage form one theme; few phospholipid terms related.

label: Golgi and endosomal vesicle trafficking
reason: COPI, Golgi organisation, endosome-Golgi retrograde transport and lysosomal sorting are one membrane trafficking theme.

label: Mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation and ketogenesis
reason: Carnitine shuttle, beta-oxidation steps and ketone body synthesis/utilisation form one fatty acid catabolic theme.

label: p53 and mitochondrial intrinsic apoptosis
reason: BH3-only activation, BAX/BAK MOMP, cytochrome c/SMAC release, apoptosome and p53-driven death transcription are one pathway.

label: Retroviral life cycle and host restriction
reason: HIV entry, reverse transcription and integration plus host restriction (APOBEC3 deamination, KRAB-ZFP/HUSH retroelement silencing) linked by retroelement/viral DNA control; HCMV, siRNA minor.

label: Axon guidance by Slit/Robo, netrin, ephrin
reason: Robo, netrin/DCC and ephrin guidance cues acting through Rac/Rho GTPases form one axon guidance theme.

label: Nucleic-acid sensing to type I interferon
reason: Endosomal TLR3/7/8/9, cGAS-STING, RLR helicases and IRF activation in dendritic cells driving type I IFN form one innate sensing theme.

label: Cobalamin, folate and methionine one-carbon metabolism
reason: B12 uptake/processing defects, folate interconversion and methionine/SAM cycle are one interconnected one-carbon theme; tube closure is folate-linked.

label: Iron, heme and transition metal homeostasis
reason: Transferrin/ferroportin iron handling, heme scavenging, copper/manganese transport and cadmium/metallothionein detoxification form one metal-ion homeostasis theme.

label: Pre-mRNA splicing and 3'-end processing
reason: Spliceosome assembly, snRNA transcription/snRNP biogenesis, polyadenylation and histone mRNA processing form one RNA processing theme.

label: Dopaminergic transmission and catecholamine transport
reason: Dopamine synthesis, secretion, reuptake and receptor signalling are one dopaminergic theme.

label: Catecholamine and monoamine metabolism
reason: BH4 synthesis, catecholamine/serotonin biosynthesis and MAO/COMT degradation are one monoamine metabolic theme.

label: TGF-beta/SMAD signalling and fibrosis
reason: TGF-beta/SMAD signalling and its control of ECM, myofibroblasts and connective tissue repair, with SMAD-regulated miRNA processing; fibrinogen odd.

label: Protein glycosylation and GAG biosynthesis
reason: N/O-glycan, GAG, glycosphingolipid and nucleotide-sugar transport biosynthesis with their CDG/dystroglycanopathy defects; a few generic migration terms odd.

label: Angiogenesis and vascular wall biology
reason: VEGF/Tie2 endothelial sprouting, shear stress response and vascular smooth muscle phenotypic regulation form one blood-vessel theme.

label: Rho family GTPase signalling
reason: RHO/RAC/CDC42 GTPase cycles and effectors (ROCK, PAK, WASP, formins) regulating actin form one theme.

label: dsRNA editing, PKR and mRNA stability control
reason: ADAR A-to-I editing and PKR/IFN regulation (dsRNA sensing) plus ARE-mediated mRNA stability and translational silencing, linked by post-transcriptional control of RNA/translation in innate responses.

label: G2/M transition and checkpoint
reason: Cyclin B-CDK1 activation, PLK1, DREAM/E2F repression and p53-mediated G2 arrest form one G2/M theme.

label: LDL receptor cholesterol uptake and SREBP control
reason: LDLR/VLDLR endocytosis, degradation and recycling with SREBP/LXR sterol feedback form one cholesterol uptake theme.

label: p53 DNA damage G2/M checkpoint
reason: Chk1/Chk2, Cdc25A degradation, p53 regulation and G2 arrest after DNA damage form one checkpoint theme.

label: mRNA nuclear export
reason: TREX/nuclear pore export of mature mRNAs and coupled 3'-end processing form one theme; lncRNA/small-RNA terms minor.

label: Blood pressure regulation: NO-cGMP and RAAS
reason: eNOS/NO-cGMP vasorelaxation, renin-angiotensin, endothelin and vascular smooth muscle tone form one blood pressure theme.

label: Chromatin modification and epigenetic regulation
reason: Histone methylation/acetylation, BAF/NuRD/CHD remodellers, DNA methylation, imprinting and X inactivation form one epigenetic theme; few odd terms.

label: Peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and bile acid synthesis
reason: Peroxisomal alpha/beta/omega oxidation of VLCFA and branched FAs plus bile acid synthesis, linked by shared peroxisomal side-chain oxidation and lipid HSP/ALD disorders.

label: Heart muscle development and growth
reason: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation, trabeculation and ventricular morphogenesis form one cardiac development theme.

label: Glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and fructose metabolism
reason: Glycolytic/gluconeogenic steps, fructose metabolism disorders, glycerol and glycogenolysis form one central carbohydrate theme; phosphocreatine odd.

label: Insulin signalling and glucose uptake
reason: Insulin receptor/IRS/AKT2 signalling, GLUT4 translocation, glycogen synthesis and adiponectin form one insulin sensitivity theme.

label: Germline, fertilization and maternal-zygotic transition
reason: Spermatogenesis/acrosome and fertilization, piRNA retroelement silencing and zygotic genome activation/epigenetic reprogramming, linked by germline-to-embryo reproductive biology; few generic RNA terms.

label: Mitotic spindle, centrosome and cytokinesis
reason: Centrosome maturation, Aurora A/PLK1, spindle assembly checkpoint and cytokinesis form one mitosis theme.
